# API Response Information

Below is the response from an API call. To help you understand the data, I've provided:

1. A detailed description of all fields in the response structure
2. The complete API response

## Response Structure

> Content-Type: application/json

- **data**: No comments found. (Type: object)
  - **data.list**: 订单列表 (Type: array)
    - **data.list[].orderId**: 订单编码 (Type: string)
    - **data.list[].orderType**: 订单类型 (Type: string)
    - **data.list[].createTime**: 下单时间 (Type: string)
    - **data.list[].beType**: 门店类型 (Type: string)
    - **data.list[].beCode**: BE编码 (Type: string)
    - **data.list[].storeCode**: 门店编码 (Type: string)
    - **data.list[].storeName**: 门店名称 (Type: string)
    - **data.list[].orderStatus**: 订单状态 (Type: string)
    - **data.list[].orderProductList**: 商品 (Type: array)
      - **data.list[].orderProductList[].productCode**: 商品code (Type: string)
      - **data.list[].orderProductList[].productName**: 商品名称 (Type: string)
      - **data.list[].orderProductList[].quantity**: 商品数量 (Type: integer)
      - **data.list[].orderProductList[].comboItemList**: 子项列表 (Type: array)
    - **data.list[].realTotalAmount**: 总金额 (Type: string)
- **message**: No comments found. (Type: string)
- **traceId**: No comments found. (Type: string)
